how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-zul-gurub-03-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8148:progress:0: ⟦E2⟧ delivers word from King Rastakhan, ⟦1⟧. The royal court is most impressed with your decimation of the Hakkari forces. I am to award you with the final weave in your talisman. Hand it to me.
rows.quest:8148:completion:0: Your journey has only just begun, young ⟦2⟧. Perhaps one day you will visit the Maelstrom and glance into the heart of the world.
rows.quest:8148:completion:1: I wish you power and fortitude!
rows.quest:8183:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E3⟧ to ⟦E2⟧ on Yojamba Isle.
rows.quest:8183:details:0: ⟦E4⟧ burns from within. Although the Soulflayer is defeated, the kernel of his power yet remains in this cursed organ.
rows.quest:8183:progress:0: ⟦3⟧, the reek of an evil soul surrounds you.  Have you been cursed by the Soulflayer?
rows.quest:8183:completion:0: Ah, the ⟦E3⟧. So the Soulflayer has been slain! Our world is saved!
rows.quest:8183:completion:1: B⟦4⟧, your service to us cannot be overstated. You truly are a hero of this realm!
rows.quest:8201:obj:0: String 5 Channeler's Heads, then return the Collection of Troll Heads to ⟦E6⟧ on Yojamba Isle.
rows.quest:8201:details:0: It is true. Hakkar now dwells in ⟦E7⟧, bathing in the power of our gods. Enthralled high priests now channel the energies of our most sacred divinities into the Soulflayer, who will soon have a strength beyond any being of ⟦E8⟧. He must be stopped!
rows.quest:8201:details:1: Take this sacred cord, and string through it the heads of the high priests responsible for channeling our gods' energy.
rows.quest:8201:details:2: When you have done this, return to me.
rows.quest:8201:progress:0: Do you have the collection of heads, ⟦5⟧?  We must stop Hakkar from gaining more power!
rows.quest:8201:completion:0: You gained the heads! You have halted the plundering of our gods' power, and weakened Hakkar!
rows.quest:8201:completion:1: Your actions are truly heroic, ⟦6⟧. May the heads of these troll thralls plead to you for mercy long after their blood chills.
rows.quest:8227:details:0: Amongst the shattered fishing lures and tackle is a rolled, silken measuring tape. Attached to the tape is a label that reads:
rows.quest:8227:progress:0: Hello there, ⟦7⟧. You here to do some fishing?
rows.quest:8227:completion:0: Why, you found my favorite measuring tape! I love this tape! I measured some of the biggest fish I ever caught with it...
rows.quest:8227:completion:1: But, I lost this tape in ⟦E7⟧... you've been to ⟦E7⟧? Did you see the fabled Gahz'ranka?
rows.quest:8227:completion:2: Well... do you want to catch him?
rows.quest:8240:obj:0: Destroy any one of the Hakkari Bijous found in ⟦E7⟧ at the Altar of ⟦E12⟧ on Yojamba Isle. When done, speak with ⟦E13⟧ nearby.
rows.quest:8240:details:0: The destruction of the various Hakkari Bijous is of grave importance to us, so much so that we welcome outsiders of the tribe to do so for themselves!
rows.quest:8240:details:1: Take any one of the bijous that you find in ⟦E7⟧ to the Altar of ⟦E12⟧ and destroy it. For this one time alone, I will give you an additional Honor Token from our tribe; this is above and beyond what you would normally receive.
rows.quest:8240:details:2: Witness for yourself the blessings of ⟦E12⟧!
rows.quest:8240:progress:0: Have you destroyed the bijou at the Altar of ⟦E12⟧? Do so, and then you will be doubly blessed by ⟦E12⟧!
rows.quest:8240:completion:0: Excellent... each bijou we wrest away from the ⟦E15⟧ God's minions is one step closer we all are to finally defeating them once and for all. You bring honor to the Zandalar - and yourself - through your noble actions.
rows.quest:8240:completion:1: Remember ⟦8⟧, you may always destroy the bijous you find in ⟦E7⟧ at the altar. For each one, you will gain recognition and an Honor Token! Just remember to have an open space in your inventory if you don't have one of the tokens already.
rows.quest:8053:obj:0: Bring ⟦E16⟧ ⟦E17⟧. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8053:details:0: You are a heathen. Heathens have a place in the tribe. Heathens are freethinkers of Zandalar. Freethinkers do not fear oppression. Freethinkers die for what they believe in. We know you would die for what you believe in. This earns our acknowledgement. This earns you a chance to prove yourself further.
rows.quest:8053:details:1: We must have the Paragons of Power. Go to ⟦E7⟧. Kill the minions of Hakkar. Return when you have what I seek. Claim the first battle gear of a Zandalar freethinker.
rows.quest:8053:progress:0: You have returned?  Do you have the Paragons of Power?  Are you wasting my time?⟦9⟧⟦10⟧I hope not, heathen.
rows.quest:8053:completion:0: You do much to honor us. Your hands drip with the blood of Hakkar's minions. You are a friend to the tribe.
rows.quest:8053:completion:1: Wear these bracers. They are the freethinker's armguards. This is what I mean about real power.
rows.quest:8054:obj:0: Bring ⟦E16⟧ a ⟦E23⟧. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8054:details:0: Your beliefs are alien to us, heathen. Ancient Zandalar were once branded as heretics. This was when the Gurubashi Empire was strong. Heathens dared to challenge the priest of Hakkar. Heathens then were hunted and killed as vermin. Those heathens never wavered in their fight against the ⟦E15⟧ God. We honor the price they paid. They are the freethinkers.
rows.quest:8054:details:1: Destroy the minions of Hakkar in ⟦E7⟧. Bring me the Paragons of Power I seek. Success will be greatly rewarded.
rows.quest:8054:progress:0: Your presence means victory?  Do you have the Paragons?  Are you dripping in the remains of your enemies?
rows.quest:8054:completion:0: Your honor is assured in the tribe. You claim many deaths in ⟦E7⟧. Enemies fall before your convictions. Enemies fall before your power.
rows.quest:8054:completion:1: This is the freethinker's belt. It is a symbol of honor. It is powerful mojo. It is now yours.
rows.quest:8055:obj:0: Bring ⟦E16⟧ a ⟦E27⟧. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
rows.quest:8055:details:0: Battle gear gives you power in the tribe. The freethinkers are honored in this way. They are zealots. They imbue their breastplates with powerful mojo. If their beliefs falter in the face of the enemy, their breastplate will not.
rows.quest:8055:details:1: You must be revered amongst us to possess such a breastplate. Go to ⟦E7⟧. Take the Paragons of Power I need. Take the Paragons most painfully from the fools inside. Bring them to me. Prove your worth as a freethinker once and for all.
rows.quest:8055:progress:0: Do you have the Paragons?  They have mojo inside them.  We must have them.  You will aid us.
rows.quest:8055:completion:0: You have done what few ever could. You have brought the minions of Hakkar to their knees. You have shown them what a freethinker can do. You have shown us how a heretic could be revered in the tribe. You have more than real power. You ARE real power.
rows.quest:8055:completion:1: Take the breastplate, freethinker. Crush those who oppose you.
